notes.title: Phantom Asylum VR Demo
notes.notes: "Phantom Asylum" is a VR horror game set in the dark and mysterious world of an abandoned mental hospital. In this labyrinth full of ghosts, try to find your way out by keeping both your wits and courage. On the thin line between reality and madness, every step can turn into a nightmare.
